channel.title: Wenxin Chen — Notes
channel.description: Notes on research, math, and things I'm learning.

item.title: Generative Models 3: Distillation
item.description: Notes on distilling diffusion models into few-step generators: flow-map-level objectives along the PF-ODE, then distribution-level methods (VSD and the DMD family) and their bilevel training.

item.title: Generative Models 2: Optimal Transport
item.description: Notes on optimal transport for generative modeling, from stable matching and Sinkhorn through Kantorovich duality to Wasserstein distances, WGAN, FID and barycenters.

item.title: Generative Models 1: Push-forward, Divergences & GANs
item.description: Notes on generative models as push-forward maps: maximum likelihood as KL minimization, variational forms of divergences, and the GANs that follow from them.

item.title: Contrastive World Model
item.description: Group-meeting notes on the Contrastive World Model (Bonnie Li, 2026): keep the RSSM, drop the pixel decoder, and learn from mutual information with features of future observations.
